comparison.objective: Rotate a shaft in V-blocks to measure runout.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain seating and end-stop contact while rolling a cylindrical workpiece through a full turn without touching the indicator.
comparison.success_condition: Sufficient valid rotation, measured runout in range, shaft reseated and released; lift, drift, or indicator contact fails.
comparison.reason: Metrology-constrained shaft rolling is physically different from screening mixed particles.
